question: Which of the following graphs can be used for the representation of a cumulative frequency distribution?
solution:
The correct answer is **O****give curve.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The graph that can be used for the representation of a cumulative frequency distribution is the Ogive curve.
 
• **An Ogive curve, also known as a cumulative frequency curve or an "S" curve**, is constructed by plotting the cumulative frequencies against the upper boundaries of the class intervals in a frequency distribution. The cumulative frequency represents the total frequency up to a particular class
